events.body:
## Context

`client/lib/queue/outbox.dart` (`OutboxItem` JSON and status fallback) and `client/lib/history/send_history.dart` (100-item cap) have no tests in `client/test/`. Needs the Flutter SDK.

## What to do

1. Add tests using `SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({})` for round-trip, unknown status and the 100-item cap.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Round-trip and unknown-status fallback tested
- [ ] History is capped at 100

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-netguardian/client && flutter test
```
